headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty extended their losing streak to an eighth consecutive week

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: Aggressive selling by foreign institutional investors (FIIs) amid heightened global risks
The Indian benchmark indices posted their longest weekly losing run in 25 years
A massive sell-off wiped out approximately Rs 9 lakh crore of investor wealth
Concerns over global inflation data and bond-driven selloffs in international markets
whatHappening: Indian stock markets are closed today, October 2, for the Gandhi Jayanti holiday
In the last session, the Sensex closed 570.59 points lower while Nifty fell to 22,421.95
Inox Air Products has filed draft papers for its upcoming initial public offering
The market is scheduled to reopen for regular trading on Monday, October 5
summary:
Indian markets are closed today for Gandhi Jayanti following a week where the Sensex and Nifty marked their eighth consecutive weekly decline.
The last session was characterized by heavy FII selling and global risk aversion, leading to a significant erosion of investor wealth.
Despite the downturn, Inox Air Products filed for an IPO, while Bajaj Auto and Max Health emerged as top losers in the previous session.
